failure.title: Docker security proof required a contradictory CSP default source
failure.note: The first focused Docker protocol retained the exact live response headers and cleanup proof after QA-DKR-009 rejected the documented production CSP despite all required directives and hardening headers being present.
failure.diagnosis: The live Docker assertion required default-src 'none', while the documented and shipped Next.js policy intentionally uses default-src 'self' with object-src and frame-ancestors set to 'none'. The harness therefore contradicted the application security policy rather than detecting a product defect.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
